deploybot: Deployment to *production* requested.

environment: prod
tag: v2.14.0
commit: a1b2c3d4e5f
started_by: elena
status: ON HOLD — CI gate failed (3 failing checks)
ci: https://ci.internal.redwood/build/84512

ci-bot: Failed checks:
- integration/db_migration_test (failed)
- smoke/login_flow (timeout)
- e2e/payment-timeout (flaky)

elena: @here rolling this up now, saw the deploybot blocked message :eyes:

raj: can we rerun just the failing jobs? looks flaky on e2e/payment-timeout often.

mike: +1 rerun might help, but integration/db_migration_test failing concerns me.

ops-oncall: logs show postgres error during test:
```
ERROR: could not extend file "base/16384/12345": No space left on device
during setup of test fixture db_migration_test
```

elena: that's not a simple flake. if it's a test infra disk issue it could cause false negatives but it's affecting the migration test which matters for prod.

raj: ok — two options: 1) revert the commit and push v2.13.9 back to prod quickly, or 2) run targeted rerun + infra cleanup. Which is faster?

mike: infra cleanup will take ~20-30m (spin new test DB, restore), rerun ~10m after. Revert+deploy previous tag might be ~15-20m including smoke checks.

elena: we have traffic hitting this feature. prefer rollback to be safe. I'll open a rollback PR and trigger deploy of `v2.13.9`.

deploybot: Rollback requested by elena. Starting deploy of tag `v2.13.9` to prod. Will update status here.

deploybot: NOTE: original deploy (v2.14.0) remains blocked by CI gate. When rollback completes we'll decide next steps for hotfix.

raj: ack. I'll investigate the failing test infra after rollback, need logs for disk pressure.

ops-oncall: filing infra ticket INC-2026 for test DB disk issue. Assigning to eng-infra.

elena: timeline: rollback start now, expect prod stable in ~20m. Will follow up with postmortem and release notes update. :thumbsup:

mike: thanks all.
